title: Ok fan, the cheaper model doesn't come with a battery
text:
Ok fan, the cheaper model doesn't come with a battery. The $8.99 (as stated) doesn't include a battery. They upcharge you $3 for the 18650 battery if you want it which really isn't bad at all, I honestly can't find one of those batteries any cheaper. So I'd say if you want a battery, may as well pay the $3 more and get that version.

SO for the fan, it is cheap plastic and lightweight. It does work well and moves a decent amount of air which is nice. I can tell it won't last forever but if you don't beat it up and abuse it- it should still last quite a while. I think it's worth the asking price.
